name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.9 degrees north of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 12 times in 4 visits over 30 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 24 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 30 hours starting 2025-04-29, at wavelengths from 1.72 to 4.79 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
